TPG, GIC, ICICI Bank acquire Aseem Infrastructure Finance for ₹5,000 crore

TPG, GIC, and ICICI Bank have jointly acquired Aseem Infrastructure Finance, a company focused on sustainable infrastructure debt financing, particularly in renewable energy and power transmission. Aseem was originally established in 2020 by the National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF). The deal is valued at ₹5,000 crore.
